prediction_ensemble: arithmetic mean of the three seed hydrographs
response_ensemble: median R7 and normalized drainage trajectory across the three seeds

pair_rule.material_disagreement: rho below 0.75 or median absolute R7 gap above 0.05

full_curve_metric: median gauge-level mean absolute difference between normalized drainage trajectories over days 0-30
full_curve_role: descriptive corroboration only; not a classification gate
uncertainty: 2,000 ecoregion-stratified bootstrap replicates with deterministic pair-specific seeds
anchor_note: The frozen outcome-blind archive provides 12 unique warm-season anchors at every target gauge, selected from quantiles of antecedent 30-day precipitation minus PET without discharge, predictions, or model states.
interpretation: one competent, exactly closed, materially disagreeing pair is a counterexample to guarantee; every convergent pair is retained and reported
blinding_note: Checkpoint selection, national prediction freezing, intervention-date selection, and closure auditing are completed without opening 2019-2024 target discharge.
